messages.subject: Error in predict (categorical variables)
parts:
Hello everyone,
I fitted a model with one categorical and one continuous variable. I still have a problem using predict when I mantain constant the continuous variable and try to predict values of density for the categories. I already make sure that none of the category has density 0 (because that was a problem at the beginning). This is the error:

ElConst  <- data.frame(Updated_Habitat=unique(c$Updated_Habitat),Elevation_meters=mean(c$Elevation_meters)
pElCost <-predict (EH_m,type="state",newdata=ElConst,appendData=TRUE)

Error in X[i, ] : sub'indice fuera de  los l'imites (which means that the subindex is out of range or bounds)

Does anybody knwo what is the problem? Again, I really appreciate your help!

Best,

Laura
